description: This file contains functions and variables for platform-specific operations related to BCM4908 devices in an OpenWrt firmware environment. It includes functions to identify firmware formats, validate images, perform upgrades, and handle UBI partitions, as well as functions specific to pkgtb firmware package management.

methods.name: get_content
methods.description: Reads a specific content segment from a file using dd with skip and count parameters.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte little-endian unsigned 32-bit integer from a file and outputs its hex representation.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_be
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte big-endian unsigned 32-bit integer from a file and outputs its hex representation.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected firmware image name for the current board.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware format and extracts metadata such as board ID from the image file.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image_name
methods.description: Retrieves the image name from a pkgtb firmware file based on configuration.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image
methods.description: Extracts image data from a pkgtb firmware file.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_upgrade_index
methods.description: Determines the upgrade index for pkgtb firmware based on current environment settings.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_commit
methods.description: Commits a new firmware state in the pkgtb environment, updating environment variables accordingly.

methods.name: platform_check_pkgtb
methods.description: Validates the presence of required pkgtb images (bootfs and rootfs) in a firmware file.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs validation checks for the firmware image, including format, device match, and integrity.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_clean_rootfs_data
methods.description: Removes and verifies root filesystem data in the UBI volume.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_pkgtb
methods.description: Performs a system upgrade using a pkgtb firmware image, updating UBI volumes accordingly.

methods.name: platform_calc_new_cferam
methods.description: Calculates the next cferam index value for bootloader updating.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_ubi
methods.description: Performs a UBI-aware upgrade, handling bootfs and rootfs partition updates, and manages cferam index.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function; identifies firmware and performs appropriate upgrade steps, including UBI upgrade or full flash.
